issues.description: Class name and file contents mismatch: the template file src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java declares a class named "AnimalFarm" (line 3) and contains a duplicated/malformed block (duplicate package declaration and duplicate class fragment around lines 10-17). The problem statement and the solution expect a public class named "Farm" (UML and solution: public class Farm). The current template name and duplicated/malformed code will cause compilation errors and prevents students from implementing or instantiating the intended Farm class as described in the assignment.
issues.suggestedFix: Replace the contents of src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java so it declares the expected public class Farm (not AnimalFarm) and remove the duplicated package declaration and duplicate/malformed class fragment. Ensure the file name and public class name match (public class Farm) and that the class compiles. Implement the Farm skeleton per the UML/problem description: private List<Animal> animals; a no-argument constructor initializing an ArrayList; getter and setter for animals; addAnimal(Animal); feedAllAnimals(); singFarmSong() delegating to a private singFarmSongVerse(Animal). Keep TODO comments as needed for pedagogical tasks, but fix the class name and remove the duplicated/invalid code so students can compile and implement the assignment.
